entries.headline: Mega Man: Dual Override devs discuss 40th anniversary title, boss difficulty 'deliberately tough'
entries.summary: In an interview, the development team said they wanted to release a long-awaited brand-new entry for the Mega Man series' 40th anniversary. The team balanced mechanics around the new Override system and intentionally set boss battles to be on the harder side. The game is planned for release in 2027 on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON's interview with the development team has been accessed; development motivation, boss difficulty, and platform and 2027 release plans all come from this interview. Currently only second-hand interview evidence exists, so media_report is maintained.

entries.headline: Activision details anti-cheat enforcement for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, lawyers deliver cease-and-desist in person
entries.summary: Activision says it has served a cease-and-desist to cheat team Elocarry, and in a long-running campaign has blocked over 375 cheat resellers, issued over 80 cease-and-desist letters, and prompted more than 30 sellers to shut down. The company also claims cheat usage dropped during the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 early access test, and a new detection system has been added to the open beta.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON's report has been accessed; the report relays Activision's public statement from August 29. The packet did not open Activision's first-party page, so all company figures are attributed as 'Activision says' and media_report is maintained.

entries.headline: Sony Music Entertainment Japan plans to acquire 23.29% of GungHo, forming capital and business alliance
entries.summary: Sony Music Entertainment Japan plans to acquire 23.29% of GungHo Online Entertainment from SON Financial, with a total transaction value of 28,635,502,500 yen. If regulatory approval is granted, the deal is expected to close on December 30, making Sony Music Entertainment Japan the largest shareholder of GungHo. GungHo will maintain its operational independence as a listed company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market.
entries.verification: Gematsu's report has been accessed; share percentage, transaction amount, expected closing date, and operational independence all come from its relay of the company announcement. The packet did not open the company's first-party announcement, so media_report is maintained.
